meta.name: dev-render-htmlcss-svg-feature
meta.description: Manual-invocation only. Five-phase feature loop (audit → ground → fixture → implement → verify) for driving a single SVG feature to Chromium parity in the grida `htmlcss::svg` renderer. Sibling to `dev-render-htmlcss-feature` (HTML/CSS path); same loop shape, different corpus (resvg-test-suite + Chrome bake) and different scoring (multi-oracle: consensus / disputed / UB).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动 SVG 渲染特性达到 Chromium 一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发 SVG 渲染器并需要自动化测试与修复流程
copy.tagline_en: Drive SVG rendering features to Chromium parity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing an SVG renderer and need automated testing and fix loops

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成一个五阶段循环（审计→研究→选测试→实现→验证），让 grida 的 SVG 渲染器逐个特性达到 Chromium 的渲染效果。
howto.when: 当你手动要求 Claude 处理某个 SVG 渲染特性（如 feSpecularLighting）时触发。不会自动启动。

say.text: 帮我让 feSpecularLighting 达到 Chromium 级别。
say.note: 启动该特性的五阶段循环。

say.text: 审计当前 SVG 渲染器中 feColorMatrix 的状态。
say.note: 执行第一阶段，查看特性在管线中的位置。

say.text: 运行 reftest 摘要，看看共识通过率。
say.note: 获取整个测试套件的通过率概览。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through a five-phase loop (audit → ground → fixture → implement → verify) to drive a single SVG feature to Chromium parity in the grida htmlcss::svg renderer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you manually ask Claude to work on a specific SVG rendering feature (e.g., feSpecularLighting). Does not auto-trigger.

say_en.text: Help me bring feSpecularLighting to Chromium parity.
say_en.note: Starts the five-phase loop for that feature.

say_en.text: Audit the current state of feColorMatrix in the SVG renderer.
say_en.note: Executes phase 1 to inspect pipeline status.

say_en.text: Run reftest summary to see the consensus pass rate.
say_en.note: Gets an overview of the entire test suite pass rate.
